text: Additional early H1/D1 observation in live patch at 22:24Z: PilotRunner.commit still names Scheduled+Done payloads with deterministic SealedNames.data(u), while failed/refused and Rerun use runId. A crash before job marker leaves that job Scheduled on resume; different successful payload bytes still poison the entire store before whitelist-digest validation. Proposed regression: successful synthetic arm emits invocation-varying bytes, crash after data/ledger seal, then resume; store must remain readable with a whitelist determinism refusal. Use attempt-unique payload names on every invocation. Routed to active author via Fray question170; not a final exact-SHA verdict.
